StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Represents an authenticated ARCSTFUG student's profile, study statistics, streak, XP, and course/lecture progress.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the student.

targetExam.description: Target competitive exam (e.g. JEE Main & Advanced 2026, NEET-UG 2026).

classLevel.description: Student class or batch level (e.g. Class 12th).

totalDppsSolved.description: Total number of Daily Practice Problem sets solved.

enrolledCourseIds.description: List of enrolled course batch IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DppAttempt.title: DppAttempt
DppAttempt.description: Stores a student's attempt, score, and completion status for a Daily Practice Problem (DPP) sheet.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the student.

dppId.description: Unique identifier of the DPP sheet.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the DPP.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Time spent solving the DPP in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was first recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudentDoubt.title: StudentDoubt
StudentDoubt.description: Stores a student's academic doubt question and the step-by-step Gemini AI Tutor explanation.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the student.

questionText.description: The academic doubt question asked by the student.

facultyReply.description: Step-by-step AI Tutor or faculty explanation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the doubt was posted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the doubt was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated student's profile and study progress metrics.

/users/{userId}/dpp_attempts/{dppId}.description: Stores each authenticated student's completed DPP scores and attempt history.

/users/{userId}/doubts/{doubtId}.description: Stores each authenticated student's posted academic doubts and AI Tutor solutions.
